test_golden_modules: test sonnet modules against golden checkpoint outputs using registered golden test classes
create_golden_test: create a golden test class by subclassing AbstractGolden and registering with the golden decorator
run_parameterized_tests: run parameterized tests over all registered golden modules using the all_goldens decorator
generate_range_tensor: generate a tensor with sequential values matching the shape and dtype of an input tensor
list_registered_goldens: list all registered golden test cases for sonnet modules
